final_message:
I drafted Ms. Venkataraman's employment agreement from the template and her signed offer letter, plus a cover memo listing changes, issues and 17 open items. The draft matches every offer letter term, and I rewrote the template provisions that don't hold up under California law (non-compete, non-solicits, invention assignment, garden leave, notice forfeiture, and the arbitration provider, Delaware venue, cost-split and confidentiality terms). I also found the offer letter's $14,550 maximum 401(k) match is too high: IRS pay limits cap it at about $10,500.

Files are in /workspace/output (both pass the docx validator and parse back cleanly):
- /workspace/output/employment-agreement-draft.docx
- /workspace/output/cover-memo.docx
